          <style>

              flex-direction: column;
            }

            /* Top title: We turn 60. Spooky! */
            .top-title {
              font-family: 'Creepster', 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif;
              font-weight: 400;
              font-size: clamp(2rem, 12vw, 6rem);
              line-height: 0.95;
              color: #363039;
              text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #872FE0;
              margin: 0;
              padding: 0;
              text-align: center;
              z-index: 2;
              position: relative;
              display: block;
            }

            .top-title .line1 {
              white-space: nowrap;
              font-size: clamp(2rem, 12vw, 6rem);
            }

            /* Photo container */
            .photo-container {
              position: relative;
              margin-top: -2rem;
              z-index: 1;
              width: 100%;
            }

            .photo-container img {
              width: 100%;
              height: auto;
              display: block;
            }

            .photo-placeholder {
              width: 100%;
              aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
              background-color: #d4cfa0;
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: center;
              color: #8a8560;
              font-family: sans-serif;
              font-size: 0.9rem;
              letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            }

            /* Bottom text: Come retire with us */
            .bottom-title {

              font-weight: 400;

              color: #89E031;
              text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #363039;
              text-align: center;
              display: block;
              position: relative;
              margin-top: -0.5rem;
              z-index: 2;
              padding: 0;
            }

            /* Event details */
            .event-details {
              margin-top: 1.5rem;
              z-index: 2;
              position: relative;
            }

            .event-details .join-text {
              font-family: 'Special Elite', 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif;
              font-weight: 400;
              font-size: 1.1rem;
              letter-spacing: 0.08em;
              text-transform: uppercase;
              color: #363039;
              margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
            }

            .event-details .detail-line {
              font-family: 'Special Elite', 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif;
              font-weight: 400;
              font-size: 1rem;

              text-transform: uppercase;
              color: #363039;
              line-height: 1.6;
            }

            .event-details .detail-line a {
              color: #872FE0;
            }

            .event-details .highlight-line {
              display: block;
              font-family: 'Creepster', 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif;
              font-size: 1.8rem;
              line-height: 1.1;
              color: #363039;
              text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #872FE0;
            }

            .event-details .highlight-line.second {
              margin-top: 0.5rem;
            }

            .event-details a.calendar-button {
              display: inline-block;
              font-family: 'Special Elite', 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif;
              font-size: 0.8rem;
              letter-spacing: 0.05em;
              text-transform: uppercase;
              color: #363039;
              text-decoration: none;
              border: 2px solid #363039;
              border-radius: 4px;
              padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem;
              margin-top: 0.5rem;
            }

            .event-details a.calendar-button:hover {
              background-color: #363039;
              color: #FF6F08;
            }

            .event-details .rsvp-line {
              font-family: 'Special Elite', 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif;
              font-weight: 400;
              font-size: 1rem;
              letter-spacing: 0.05em;
              text-transform: uppercase;
              color: #363039;
              margin-top: 1.5rem;
            }

            @media (max-width: 600px) {
              .top-title {
                margin-top: 30px;
              }
              .photo-container {
                margin-top: -1rem;
              }
              .bottom-title {
                font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 7vw, 3rem);
                margin-top: -0.25rem;
              }
            }

            /* Spooky flicker: emoji jump-scare flashes at irregular intervals */
            .flicker-container {
              position: fixed;
              top: 0;
              left: 0;
              width: 100%;
              height: 100%;
              pointer-events: none;
              z-index: 9999;
              overflow: hidden;
            }

            .flicker {
              position: absolute;
              font-size: 3rem;
              opacity: 0;
              animation: flicker-flash ease-in-out infinite;
            }

            @keyframes flicker-flash {
              0%, 92%, 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.5); }
              94% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.3); }
              97% { opacity: 0.9; transform: scale(1); }
              98% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.4); }
            }

            /* Hide default quarto elements */
            #title-block-header { display: none; }
            .page-columns { padding: 0; }
            main.content { padding: 0; margin: 0; }
          </style>
